trips.trip_title: Winter Wonderland in Himachal: Manali & Kasol Adventure
trips.best_time_to_visit: December - February (for snow and winter sports)

must_do_activities.name: Travel to Manali
must_do_activities.description: Arrive in Manali, check into your accommodation, and spend the evening exploring Old Manali and its charming cafes.

cities.name: Solang Valley
cities.address: Solang Valley, Manali, Himachal Pradesh, India

must_do_activities.name: Adventure in Solang Valley
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy paragliding (if weather permits), zorbing, or simply playing in the snow and taking in the panoramic views.

must_do_activities.name: Hadimba Devi Temple
must_do_activities.description: Visit the ancient Hadimba Devi Temple, a unique wooden temple nestled amidst cedar forests.

must_do_activities.name: Naggar Castle
must_do_activities.description: Explore Naggar Castle, a historic structure offering stunning views of the Beas Valley.

must_do_activities.name: Roerich Art Gallery
must_do_activities.description: Visit the Roerich Art Gallery in Naggar to admire the works of Russian artist Nicholas Roerich.

must_do_activities.name: Local Himachali Cuisine
must_do_activities.description: Savor traditional Himachali dishes at a local eatery in Naggar or Manali.

must_do_activities.name: Travel to Kasol
must_do_activities.description: Journey to the picturesque village of Kasol in Parvati Valley, known for its serene beauty and hippie culture.

must_do_activities.name: Explore Kasol Market
must_do_activities.description: Stroll through the vibrant Kasol market, soaking in the bohemian vibe and enjoying Israeli cafes.

must_do_activities.name: Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara
must_do_activities.description: Visit the sacred Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and take a dip in its hot springs, believed to have medicinal properties.

must_do_activities.name: Chalal Village Trek
must_do_activities.description: Embark on a short, scenic trek to Chalal village from Kasol, enjoying the riverside views.

must_do_activities.name: Day trip to Tosh Village
must_do_activities.description: Take a day trip to the enchanting Tosh village, known for its apple orchards and stunning views of the Parvati Valley. Enjoy a peaceful walk and local food.

must_do_activities.name: Departure from Kasol
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy a final breakfast in Kasol before departing for your onward journey.

trips.trip_title: Royal Retreat in Rajasthan: Udaipur & Jaipur

must_do_activities.name: Arrive in Udaipur
must_do_activities.description: Reach Udaipur, check into your hotel, and spend the evening relaxing by Lake Pichola, enjoying the scenic beauty.

must_do_activities.name: City Palace
must_do_activities.description: Explore the majestic City Palace, a complex of palaces, courtyards, and gardens offering stunning lake views.

must_do_activities.name: Boat Ride on Lake Pichola
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy a serene boat ride on Lake Pichola, visiting Jag Mandir island.

must_do_activities.name: Rooftop Dinner
must_do_activities.description: Have dinner at a rooftop restaurant overlooking Lake Pichola for a magical experience.

must_do_activities.name: Saheliyon Ki Bari
must_do_activities.description: Visit Saheliyon Ki Bari, the beautiful Garden of Maidens, known for its fountains and kiosks.

must_do_activities.name: Jagdish Temple
must_do_activities.description: Explore the grand Indo-Aryan Jagdish Temple, dedicated to Lord Vishnu.

must_do_activities.name: Shopping in Local Markets
must_do_activities.description: Discover local handicrafts, textiles, and traditional Rajasthani items in Udaipur's bustling markets.

must_do_activities.name: Travel to Jaipur
must_do_activities.description: Take a train or bus to Jaipur, the Pink City. Check into your hotel and relax.

must_do_activities.name: Johari Bazaar
must_do_activities.description: In the evening, take a stroll through Johari Bazaar, famous for its jewelry and gemstones.

must_do_activities.name: Amber Fort
must_do_activities.description: Visit the magnificent Amber Fort, experiencing an elephant ride or jeep safari up to the fort entrance.

must_do_activities.name: Hawa Mahal
must_do_activities.description: Admire the iconic Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds) from outside for its unique architecture.

must_do_activities.name: City Palace, Jaipur
must_do_activities.description: Explore the Jaipur City Palace, a complex of palaces, gardens, and courtyards.

must_do_activities.name: Nahargarh Fort
must_do_activities.description: Visit Nahargarh Fort, offering breathtaking sunset views over Jaipur.

must_do_activities.name: Jal Mahal
must_do_activities.description: View the beautiful Water Palace, Jal Mahal, from the roadside.

must_do_activities.name: Rajasthani Thali
must_do_activities.description: Indulge in a traditional Rajasthani Thali for dinner, experiencing the rich flavors of the region.

must_do_activities.name: Departure from Jaipur
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy a final breakfast in Jaipur and depart for your onward journey.

must_do_activities.name: Arrive in Bangkok
must_do_activities.description: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) or Don Mueang Airport (DMK), transfer to your hotel, and settle in. In the evening, explore the vibrant Sukhumvit area.

must_do_activities.name: Grand Palace & Wat Phra Kaeo
must_do_activities.description: Visit the magnificent Grand Palace and the Temple of the Emerald Buddha (Wat Phra Kaeo).

must_do_activities.name: Wat Arun
must_do_activities.description: Take a ferry across the Chao Phraya River to visit Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn).

must_do_activities.name: Street Food Tour
must_do_activities.description: Experience Bangkok's famous street food scene, perhaps in Yaowarat (Chinatown).

must_do_activities.name: Floating Market
must_do_activities.description: Take a half-day trip to Damnoen Saduak or Amphawa Floating Market for a unique cultural experience.

must_do_activities.name: Shopping at MBK Center or Siam Paragon
must_do_activities.description: Spend the afternoon shopping at one of Bangkok's mega malls.

must_do_activities.name: Chao Phraya River Cruise
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy a dinner cruise on the Chao Phraya River in the evening.

must_do_activities.name: Travel to Krabi
must_do_activities.description: Take a morning flight from Bangkok to Krabi. Check into your hotel in Ao Nang or Krabi Town.

must_do_activities.name: Ao Nang Beach
must_do_activities.description: Spend the afternoon relaxing on Ao Nang Beach and enjoy a sunset dinner by the sea.

must_do_activities.name: Four Island Tour
must_do_activities.description: Embark on an island hopping tour to stunning islands like Phra Nang Cave Beach, Chicken Island, Tup Island, and Poda Island.

must_do_activities.name: Railay Beach
must_do_activities.description: Take a longtail boat to Railay Beach, known for its dramatic limestone cliffs, rock climbing, and beautiful beaches. Explore Railay East, Railay West, and Phra Nang Cave.

must_do_activities.name: Departure from Krabi
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy a final breakfast in Krabi before transferring to Krabi International Airport (KBV) for your flight back home.

trips.trip_title: Serene South: Kerala Backwaters & Hill Stations

must_do_activities.name: Arrive in Kochi
must_do_activities.description: Arrive at Kochi International Airport (COK), transfer to your accommodation. Explore Fort Kochi in the evening, enjoying the colonial architecture and Chinese Fishing Nets.

must_do_activities.name: Mattancherry Palace
must_do_activities.description: Visit the Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace) and the Jewish Synagogue in Jew Town.

must_do_activities.name: Kathakali Performance
must_do_activities.description: In the evening, witness a traditional Kathakali dance performance.

must_do_activities.name: Seafood in Fort Kochi
must_do_activities.description: Relish fresh seafood at one of the many restaurants in Fort Kochi.

must_do_activities.name: Travel to Alleppey (Alappuzha)
must_do_activities.description: Travel to Alleppey, the 'Venice of the East'. Check into a houseboat for an overnight stay.

must_do_activities.name: Houseboat Experience
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy cruising through the serene backwaters, witnessing local life and lush greenery from your houseboat.

must_do_activities.name: Travel to Munnar
must_do_activities.description: After breakfast on the houseboat, disembark and proceed to the hill station of Munnar, known for its tea plantations.

must_do_activities.name: Relax and Enjoy Scenery
must_do_activities.description: Check into your resort and spend the evening enjoying the cool climate and panoramic views.

must_do_activities.name: Tea Plantations & Museum
must_do_activities.description: Explore the lush tea gardens, visit the Tata Tea Museum to learn about tea processing.

must_do_activities.name: Mattupetty Dam
must_do_activities.description: Visit Mattupetty Dam, Kundala Lake, and Echo Point for scenic beauty and boating opportunities.

must_do_activities.name: Eravikulam National Park
must_do_activities.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park (if open and accessible during winter), home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr.

must_do_activities.name: Anamudi Peak Viewpoint
must_do_activities.description: Enjoy views of Anamudi Peak, the highest peak in South India.

must_do_activities.name: Spice Plantation Tour
must_do_activities.description: Take a guided tour of a local spice plantation to learn about various spices grown in the region.

must_do_activities.name: Departure from Kochi
must_do_activities.description: Travel back to Kochi from Munnar and depart from Kochi International Airport for your onward journey.
